root_cause: The merchant is on a fixed blended MDR rate of 2.0% which exceeds the true underlying network cost of 1.64%, causing structural margin leakage.
diagnosis: Across total card volume of Rs 2,064,704.49, the merchant was billed Rs 41,294.09 under a blended pricing model versus a true network cost of Rs 33,954.93. Note that this comparison relies on an illustrative modeled benchmark.
action_rationale: Switching to an Interchange-Plus pricing model directly unbundles processor margin from network fees, allowing the merchant to capture the 0.36% spread and eliminate structural overpayment.
